ms.label: 3(d)
ms.text:
M1
heat to melting point OR cool to freezing point of the sample and measure melting point
OR
cool to 0 °C and observe if it’s freezing OR cool below 0 °C and then allow to warm and observe if it’s melting
M2 either:
(only) pure water melts / freezes at 0 °C / sharp melting point / if not 0 °C then it must be impure
OR
impure water melts / freezes at a lower melting point than 0 °C / melts over a range of temperatures
OR
compare the melting point of the water sample to the melting point of (known) pure water.
